# Ajoke Tella

> Ajoke Tella is a commercial leader and advisor, based in London and Lagos, who helps startups, SMEs and established companies win and grow complex, high value B2B revenue. She draws on more than a decade of enterprise sales to tier 1 and tier 2 banks, asset managers, hedge funds and family offices across EMEA at ICE Data Services, FactSet, Options Technology and Bank of America Merrill Lynch.

She works with three kinds of client: companies that are selling without a sales function (Build), companies whose sales team is underperforming or has outgrown how it started (Fix and Scale), and companies that want to win enterprise accounts (Move Upmarket). Most engagements start with a Commercial Diagnostic: a two to three week review with a written diagnosis and plan. From London she serves the UK, Europe and further afield, including the United States and the Gulf; from Lagos she serves Nigeria and the rest of Africa. She also speaks, hosts and moderates on enterprise growth and commercial leadership. Fees depend on scope and are not published.
